workstreams.name: Anspruchsgrundlagen aus dem Kaufvertragsrecht (BGB)
workstreams.goal: Identify statutory and jurisprudential bases for claims (e.g., Mängelbeseitigung, Rücktritt, Schadensersatz) under §§ 935 ff. BGB, especially regarding hidden defects and fraudulent misrepresentation

workstreams.name: Gefälschter Energieausweis & irrtümliche Erklärung
workstreams.goal: Assess liability under §§ 117, 119 BGB (fraudulent misrepresentation / erroneous declaration) and relevance of falsified energy certificate

workstreams.name: Baubewilligungsmangel & bauliche Unzulässigkeit
workstreams.goal: Determine whether unapproved extension constitutes material defect (§ 935 BGB) or violates public order (§ 879 BGB), and implications for value depreciation

synthesis_focus: Prioritize OGH jurisprudence on hidden defects (Schimmelpilz, falsche Angaben im Verkaufskatalog), unapproved extensions as material defect, and fraudulent misrepresentation (§§ 117, 123 BGB) in commercial residential property transactions.
